### Hi! We're Doxis, The Document Intelligence Company.

Some of you perhaps know us as SER, before we took the exciting step to unite our company under the Doxis brand in January 2026.

We're a global leader in intelligent content automation with more than **3,000 customers,** over **5 million users** **,** more than900 employeesand a shiny **Gartner® Leader** badge.

Doxis represents so much more than numbers and badges:

- Behind **our customers are global leaders** achieving smarter and faster processes and better ways of working with AI-first Document Intelligence.
- We aren't just a global team of 900+ employees. We are kind and hard-working people who are **obsessed with our customers' success**.
- Our Leader recognition from analysts like Gartner and IDC represent **decades of expertise and a constant drive to innovate** and deliver the best possible product.

That’s who Doxis really is.

## Why are we The Document Intelligence Company?

We tackle big, complex problems enterprises know too well: too many documents, too many systems and way too much manual work costing you time and money.

As **The Document Intelligence Company**, we power your entire document lifecycle on one AI-first platform — bringing together [document management](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/document-management), [AI](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/content-understanding) and [process automation](https://www.doxis.com/en/automate-workflows) to help you gather, analyze, manage, automate, act on, generate and secure billions of documents across your business.

## Our mission

At Doxis, we want to change the business world and revolutionize how you manage and automate business processes with Document Intelligence.

Our goal is to maximize your ROI: **Return on Information**.

## Our values

**Passion for customer success**

At Doxis, customer success is our success. Whether solving complex issues or guiding key implementations, we show up with care and commitment. Across teams and borders we go the extra mile out of genuine passion.

![](https://www.doxis.com/files/content/images/unternehmen/about-us/5-star-doxi.gif)

![](https://www.doxis.com/files/content/images/unternehmen/about-us/expertise-doxi.gif)

**Experts in everything we do**

Expertise is the foundation of the value we bring to customers, partners and each other. At Doxis, learning never stops. True expertise means striving for excellence, learning from mistakes and improving every day.

**Kindness**

Kindness is not just a gesture, it’s a mindset at Doxis. Yes, results matter, but how we achieve them matters just as much. Empathy, patience, and respect guide every interaction.

![](https://www.doxis.com/files/content/images/unternehmen/about-us/heart-doxi.gif)

![](https://www.doxis.com/files/content/images/unternehmen/about-us/doximan.gif)

**Driven by entrepreneurial spirit**

Doxis moves with vision, courage and an entrepreneurial mindset. Big ideas are welcomed, and initiative is part of daily life. We adapt quickly, pursue what works and transform what doesn’t. This spirit turns challenges into opportunities – and drives the future success of our customers, partners and our teams.

**We love fun**

Fun is part of who we are, not just in celebrating wins but in tackling challenges together. It’s the joy of solving problems, hitting goals and pushing limits. Fun fuels performance, sparks creativity and keeps us connected. With energy (and our mascot Doxi), we bring positivity into everything we do.

![](https://www.doxis.com/files/content/images/unternehmen/about-us/party-doxi.gif)
